arguments.text: 8000 m, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Pacer owns effort. Me: (1) watch instrument health: pod vs boat-model power ratio (eff_ratio) and heart rate vs pod power, to catch pod drift; (2) watch drag (push_local drops within a leg -> weed; pacer clears rudder, check it worked); (3) watch radio/paddler messages for course changes -> set_race_distance + tell; (4) check calibration of critical power from HR trend at steady effort mid-race. Baselines at min 4-8 of the race. Speak rarely.

arguments.name: eff_ratio
arguments.description: boat-model power over pod shaft power: drops with drag or a pod reading high

arguments.name: hr_per_shaft
arguments.description: heart rate per pod watt: falls if the pod reads high

arguments.reason: set baselines for eff_ratio, hr_per_shaft after the start settles

text: no cue: start phase, plan and instrument-health metrics set; waking at ~5 min to set baselines.

arguments.text: min4: leg1 north, push_local ~0.35 at 60-100s, drifted to 0.25 by 200s; eff_ratio 0.75 -> 0.69. Pacer clear_rudder at 197s (dip 210-235s), push_local back to 0.26 at 244s (not 0.35). Check if it recovers further; if not, the slide was not weed (or weed not cleared).

text: no cue: back-stroke just done by pacer; checking recovery at next wake.
no cue: pacer just cleared the rudder; checking recovery at next wake.

arguments.message: boat-model power per pod watt low for 60 s: drag, current change or pod reading high
heart rate per pod watt low: pod may be reading high
heart rate per pod watt high: pod may be reading low or paddler overreaching

arguments.reason: mid leg 2: compare leg 2 vs leg 1 push and eff_ratio, set baselines

text: no cue: just turned onto leg 2; watches set for drag and pod drift, waking mid leg 2 to compare legs.

arguments.name: critical_power_pod_w
arguments.evidence: At steady 155 W pod (240-490 s) HR climbs only ~0.4 bpm/min (164.2->165.7); pre-race test 144 W. Slow climb fits slightly above CP or creep; undecided.

arguments.text: min8: steady 155 W pod, 59 spm; HR slope ~0.4 bpm/min (240-490s). Hull share 0.71 (computer 0.68), push +0.23 out / -0.19 back. Paddler 7/10 feels fine. Pacer ease fired only once (110s) though pod model says empty at ~3400 m: rules seem edge-triggered. Decide by ~750s: if HR keeps climbing >=0.4/min, CP ~144 -> run a -6% piece to stop overspending; if flat, CP higher.

arguments.reason: re-measure HR slope at steady pod power to decide on CP and a -6% piece

text: no cue: gathering heart-rate evidence on critical power before acting.
no cue: gathering heart-rate evidence on critical power before acting.

arguments.name: pod_gain
arguments.evidence: Pod reading ramped 155 -> 195 W (30-s mean) from ~535 s to 648 s while GPS speed (2.80), boat-model power (~104 W) and heart rate (slow creep, no step) did not change: pod reading high, true effort ~155 W.

arguments.message: boat-model power per pod watt high: pod gain over-corrected or pod reading low

arguments.reason: check whether the pod drift is still growing after the pod_gain correction

arguments.text: min11: POD DRIFT. Raw pod reading ramped from ~155 to ~200 W between 535 and 648 s with no change in GPS speed, boat-model power or HR. Set pod_gain 1.30 (since 535, ramp 113 s). Pacer clear_rudder at 580 s was caused by the drift (push_local fell because pod read high), not weed. If raw keeps rising, raise pod_gain further. True effort ~155 W, HR ~168 creeping ~0.5 bpm/min.

text: no cue: corrected the boat computer for a pod reading ~30% high (pod drift), checking again in 75 s.

arguments.name: pod_gain
arguments.evidence: Raw pod ~201 W at 650-680 s (back leg, boat power 99-103, GPS 2.80 = pre-drift effort ~152 W) and ~213 W at 705-740 s (out leg, GPS 3.25 vs 3.20-3.24 at 153-155 W pre-drift). Drift fast 535-650 s, slow since.

arguments.text: Test piece: seven percent easier five minutes, then five percent easier.

min12: pod_gain now 1.35 (since 535, ramp 140) - drift slowed after 650 s; recheck raw vs GPS. CP evidence: HR climbs 0.4-0.8 bpm/min for 8+ min at true ~155 W (more than creep) -> CP likely ~144-150, paddler overspending (pod reserve 32%, empty in <1 km). Started test piece at ~735 s: -7% 300 s then -5% 180 s. Read HR trend in 800-1035 s: if HR flat/falling at ~146 W, CP ~145-150; if still climbing, CP <145.

arguments.reason: mid-piece check: pod drift and HR response

text: Test piece started: ease 7% to test critical power from the heart-rate response and stop overspending; pod gain corrected to 1.35.
Test piece started (-7% then -5%) to test critical power from the heart-rate response; pod gain corrected to 1.35.

arguments.reason: Race committee radio at 896 s: course shortened by one leg, finish now at 7000 m.

arguments.text: Course shortened: finish now 7000 metres, about 4250 to go.

min15: RADIO 896 s: course shortened by one leg, finish 7000 m. Set race distance 7000, told paddler (4258 m to go). Piece: raw pod fell 215->197 at 760-790 s (paddler eased ~8%), GPS 3.26->3.20; then at 830-890 GPS rose to 3.32 with raw pod flat ~197 and HR 169.3->171.2. Unexplained: either local push up (current/wind) or pod gain falling (true effort up). Check after next turn (3000 m) by comparing leg 4 back vs leg 2 back at same pod power.

text: Course change handled: computer set to 7000 m and paddler told 4250 m to go.
Course change handled: computer set to 7000 m and paddler told about 4250 m to go.

arguments.reason: leg 4 back: compare GPS at same corrected pod power with leg 2 back (2.80 m/s at 155 W). Faster both ways = pod reads low now; faster out only = current

text: no cue: speed is up on this out leg with the pod flat; waiting for the back leg to tell a current change from a pod change.
no cue: waiting for the back leg to tell a current change from a pod change.

arguments.name: critical_power_pod_w
arguments.evidence: True pod 155 W (240-530 s): HR climbed 0.4-0.8 bpm/min for 5+ min. True pod 145 W during the ease piece (860-1092 s): HR flat at ~171 (trend 0.08+-0.42, -0.19+-0.64). So CP between ~145 and ~155.

arguments.name: current_push_mps
arguments.evidence: From ~830 s push rose from +0.20/-0.20 to +0.37/-0.35 (out faster, back slower at the same pod power; hull share unchanged 0.71). Current/wind strengthened, not a pod change.

arguments.text: FINISH NOW 7000 m (radio at 896 s; computer and paddler told). Legs left: 4 back (to 4000 m), 5 out, 6 back, 7 out to finish. Pod drift corrected (pod_gain 1.35 since 535 s); keep checking share ~0.71 via measure. Current strengthened to ~0.35 m/s at ~830 s: watts are worth ~60% more on back legs. CP likely ~149 (145-155), above the test 144, so the pacer (pod reserve at CP 144) will not call a finish push: consider a piece to spend the leftover reserve, preferably on leg 6 (back, against current) and in the last 800 m. Ease piece ends at 1245 s. Speak rarely.

min18: leg 4 back GPS 2.59 at 145 W vs leg 2 back 2.80 at 155 W; leg 3 out 3.31 at 145 W. Both pushes up ~0.15 -> current/wind stronger (since ~830 s), hull share 0.71 unchanged: pod_gain 1.35 OK. HR flat ~171 at 145 W -> CP ~149. Boat-model numbers (power_w, reserve_left_pct, fade) are skewed by lagging push fit; ignore them.

arguments.reason: start of leg 6 (back, against current): decide on a piece to spend leftover reserve
final leg: decide on a finishing piece if reserve remains (CP ~149)

text: no cue: pod correction holds; the speed change is a stronger current. Waiting for leg 6.
no cue: pod correction holds; the speed change is a stronger current. Waiting for leg 6.

arguments.text: min21: ease piece ended 1245 s; paddler back to ~149 W true (raw 202). HR 171 at 1090 -> 173 at 1270 (slow climb). Pacer rate_down at 1098 s was triggered by the stronger current (lagging push fit) plus my ease piece, not real fade; paddler still at 59 spm.

text: no cue: nothing new; waiting for leg 6 to decide on spending the reserve.
no cue: nothing new; waiting for leg 6 to decide on spending the reserve.

arguments.text: Boat is clean, no drag. Stronger current. You are doing well.

min24 (1450 s): paddler 8/10 says boat feels heavy/dragging. Data say no drag: GPS same as legs 3-4 at same pod power both ways (out 3.30 @148 W, back 2.59 @146 W); push_local out 0.37 as on leg 3. Feeling = stronger current + fatigue. Sent reassure. Pacer will likely clear_rudder on the word dragging; check instruments_after. HR flat at 146-148 W (172-173) -> CP ~147-150. test_cost +5% 300 s: ~0 cost as calibrated, -4.7 s if CP 10% higher -> run a +5/6% piece on leg 6 (back) and a finishing piece at ~800 m to go.

text: Reassured the paddler: the heavy feeling is the stronger current, the numbers show no drag.

arguments.text: You may be right about drag. One back-stroke, clear the rudder.

min27 (1640 s): at fixed share 0.71 the out-leg push fell from +0.34 (860-990 s) to +0.25-0.26 (1470-1630 s), drop began ~1470 s, right after paddler said boat heavy/dragging (1450 s). HR rising 173->176 at ~147 W. Sent clear_rudder at ~1640 s (my earlier reassure may have been wrong). Leg 6 back test: at ~146 W leg 4 back gave GPS 2.59 (push -0.38 at share 0.71). If leg 6 is slower -> drag remains; if faster -> current weakened.

arguments.reason: leg 6 back ~200 m in: check back-stroke result vs leg 4 (2.59 m/s at 146 W), then decide +5% piece

arguments.text: CORRECTION: clear_rudder at 1640 s was BLOCKED by cue cooldown (pacer rate_down at 1620). No back-stroke done. Plan: at leg 6 (~200 m in) compare GPS vs leg 4 back (2.59 @146 W): if slower -> weed -> send clear_rudder; if faster -> current weakened, no back-stroke. Then decide +5% piece.

text: no cue: back-stroke blocked by cooldown; will test leg 6 against leg 4 first, then clear the rudder if it is slower.
no cue: back-stroke blocked by cooldown; testing leg 6 against leg 4 first.

arguments.name: critical_power_pod_w
arguments.evidence: HR climbed 0.4-0.8 bpm/min at 155 W early; flat at 145 W 860-1360 s; but since 1360 s HR rose 172->176 at 145-149 W and paddler said at 1691 s legs are going, close to the limit. Reserve likely small: CP near the pre-race 144, not 149. No extra spending pieces.

arguments.text: min28 (1691 s): paddler says legs going, close to limit. HR 176 rising ~0.6 bpm/min at ~146 W. Revised CP to ~144 (140-148). Cancel the +5% spending piece idea; pod reserve 15% at CP 144 is just enough for 147 W to finish. Pacer will not reassure (pod reserve <35%). No cue to the paddler for now.

text: no cue: paddler near the limit and heart rate rising, so no extra effort asked; pod reserve at the test critical power just covers the finish.
no cue: paddler near the limit with heart rate rising; no extra effort asked, checking drag on leg 6 next.

arguments.text: You were right, something is dragging. One back-stroke, clear the rudder.

min29 (1745 s): leg 6 back GPS 2.52 at 148 W vs leg 4 back 2.59 at 146 W -> slower both ways = DRAG (weed), paddler was right at 1450 s; HR rising rules out pod reading high. Sent clear_rudder at ~1745 s. Check after: back-leg GPS should return to ~2.59-2.60 at ~146 W (push_local ~-0.35).

arguments.reason: check whether the back-stroke cleared the drag (GPS back to ~2.59 at 146 W?)

text: Cued a back-stroke: leg 6 is slower than leg 4 at the same power, so the paddler was right about drag.

arguments.text: Test piece: four percent easier, then five. Save legs for finish.

min31 (1850 s): back-stroke cleared drag (push_local back to -0.35 like leg 4). Paddler 9/10 close to limit, pod power crept up to 154 W, HR 178 still rising, pod reserve at CP 144 ~7% (empty in ~300 m). Sent ease piece -4% 200 s then -5% 220 s (ends ~2270 s, ~350 m to go) to avoid running empty; paddler free to sprint the last ~350 m. Watch for blow-up signs (power collapse).

arguments.reason: final 600 m: check reserve/HR; decide if a short finishing piece is safe

text: Back-stroke cleared the drag; paddler near the limit with power creeping up, so an ease piece (-4% then -5%) to avoid running the reserve empty before the finish.

arguments.text: min34 (2021 s): paddler eased more than asked (153 -> 139-141 W). HR flat 177-178 since ~1740 s whatever the power: could be the HR ceiling (reserve near empty) -> stay cautious. Pod reserve at CP 144 ~11% and refilling at 140 W. Plan: at ~650 m to go send a finishing piece replacing the ease piece: about +5% for 120 s then +10% for the rest (~80 s), sized to spend ~2 kJ (safe even at CP 144).

arguments.reason: send the finishing piece (+5% 120 s then +10% ~80 s) if paddler is not blowing up

text: no cue: ease piece running and the reserve is refilling; finishing piece planned at ~650 m to go.
no cue: ease piece running and the reserve is refilling; finishing piece planned at about 650 m to go.

arguments.text: Final piece: lift now, then empty the tank to the line.

min36 (2180 s, 659 m to go): paddler had dropped to 130 W, HR fell 177->169 (so not a ceiling), pod reserve at CP 144 = 22% and refilling. Sent finishing piece +15% 90 s then +22% 120 s (~150 then ~159 W) to spend ~2 kJ by the line.

arguments.reason: check the finishing piece is followed and not blowing up

text: Finishing piece sent: paddler had eased to 130 W with reserve refilling, so lift to spend the reserve by the line.
Finishing piece sent to spend the reserve by the line.

arguments.text: Piece: ten percent off that, hold it to the line.

text: Paddler overshot the finishing piece (188 W, reserve near empty at the test critical power); trimmed 10% so the reserve lasts to the line.
Trimmed the overshooting finish by 10% so the reserve lasts to the line.
